headlines.title: Chinese tech giant Huawei convicted of federal charges, including fraud
headlines.description: Chinese tech giant Huawei was convicted of multiple federal charges in New York on Tuesday after prosecutors accused the company of stealing technology from U.S. companies, abusing the American financial system and helping Iran spy on its citizens.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang apologizes to Nvidia staff, saying he went ‘too far’ and is in therapy
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang made a triumphant return to the semiconductor giant in an all-hands meeting Tuesday morning, apologizing to staff for his conduct during his previous stint at the company’s helm and vowing to do better this time around.

headlines.title: Lab says humanoid robot uses living human neurons to help think
headlines.description: A San Francisco lab is showing off Iris, a humanoid robot with a mood informed by real, living human cells. The lab says the robot communicates wirelessly with lab-grown neurons that originated with human stem cells, which work with complicated AI to help her decide how to feel. It’s an early step for an experiment into how human intelligence can meet artificial intelligence. NBC News’ Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Israeli tech company develops AI chatbot to triage mental health and PTSD patients
headlines.description: As AI continues to spread into many different industries, one tech company developed an avatar chatbot to help triage and diagnose patients seeking mental health treatments. NBC News’ Keir Simmons spoke with the people at the forefront of the new technology.

headlines.title: Blanche assures he would have told Trump about any crimes Jensen Huang committed
headlines.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche told reporters that he "certainly" would have told President Trump if the Department of Justice was investigating Jensen Huang for committing any crimes before his reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO.

headlines.title: N.Y. Gov. Hochul signs AI-powered toy ban into law
headlines.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul signed a bill to ban the sale and manufacture of AI-powered toys. The signing comes amid growing scrutiny of the toys’ safety and long-term impacts.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as NVIDIA CEO
headlines.description: Less than a week after the company’s Board Chair said Huang would not be reinstated as CEO, today he was. The company’s stock soared on the news as overall markets also climbed dramatically. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Trump’s role in bringing Huang back to Nvidia
headlines.description: President Trump proudly shared news of his role in Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia as CEO today, but the move also brought sharp bipartisan criticism. NBC News’ Chief White House Correspondent Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Markets rebound after Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang
headlines.description: Major U.S. stock indexes soared after Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia's CEO. NBC News' Allie Canal and Investopedia editor-in-chief Caleb Silver break down the numbers.

headlines.title: Trump says he has been speaking to Nvidia's board 'directly and indirectly'
headlines.description: President Trump called into CNBC to discuss Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, saying the company acted "really responsibly." NBC News' Gabe Gutierrez reports from the White House on what else the president had to say about Huang's return to his leadership role.

headlines.title: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
headlines.description: AI giant Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as president and CEO, just 11 days after he stepped down amid a series of scandals, including one where he held an extramarital relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO of Nvidia
headlines.description: Nvidia's board of directors announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as its president and chief executive officer. NBC News' Jared Perlo reports on the scandal that caused Huang's original resignation and the decision to return him to the role.
